name: Bloodpetal Poison
label: Quest
description: Bloodpetal Poison: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater. It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of an adventurer can hope to collect the ingredients.

You can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater. Gorishi stings are from the giant flying wasps inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With the Un'Goro soil I have collected, the toxin is easily concocted...
